import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
scatter = axes[0, 0].scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                             c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='viridis', 
                             s=df['Physical Activity Level']/2, alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Stress Level\n(Size = Physical Activity)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[0, 0])
cbar.set_label('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=10)

# 2. Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation (top 10)
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation').agg({
    'Sleep Duration': 'mean',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean',
    'Stress Level': 'mean'
}).sort_values('Sleep Duration', ascending=False).head(10)

x = np.arange(len(occupation_sleep))
width = 0.25
axes[0, 1].bar(x - width, occupation_sleep['Sleep Duration'], width, label='Sleep Duration', color='skyblue')
axes[0, 1].bar(x, occupation_sleep['Quality of Sleep'], width, label='Quality of Sleep', color='lightgreen')
axes[0, 1].bar(x + width, occupation_sleep['Stress Level'], width, label='Stress Level', color='salmon')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Average Score', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Top 10 Occupations: Sleep & Stress Metrics', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xticks(x)
axes[0, 1].set_xticklabels(occupation_sleep.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
axes[0, 1].legend()

# 3. Distribution of Sleep Duration by BMI Category
bmi_order = ['Underweight', 'Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
for bmi in bmi_order:
    subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi]['Sleep Duration']
    axes[0, 2].hist(subset, alpha=0.5, label=bmi, bins=15)
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 2].legend()

# 4. Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Variables
numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                  'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
im = axes[1, 0].imshow(corr_matrix, cmap='coolwarm', vmin=-1, vmax=1)
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(np.arange(len(numerical_cols)))
axes[1, 0].set_yticks(np.arange(len(numerical_cols)))
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(numerical_cols, rotation=45, ha='right')
axes[1, 0].set_yticklabels(numerical_cols)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Correlation Heatmap of Health Metrics', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=axes[1, 0])
cbar.set_label('Correlation Coefficient', fontsize=10)

# Add correlation values
for i in range(len(numerical_cols)):
    for j in range(len(numerical_cols)):
        text = axes[1, 0].text(j, i, f'{corr_matrix.iloc[i, j]:.2f}',
                               ha="center", va="center", color="black", fontsize=8)

# 5. Daily Steps vs Physical Activity by Gender
gender_colors = {'Male': 'steelblue', 'Female': 'lightcoral'}
for gender, color in gender_colors.items():
    gender_data = df[df['Gender'] == gender]
    axes[1, 1].scatter(gender_data['Physical Activity Level'], gender_data['Daily Steps'],
                       alpha=0.6, color=color, label=gender, s=50)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Physical Activity vs Daily Steps by Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].legend()

# 6. Sleep Disorder Analysis
if 'Sleep Disorder' in df.columns:
    disorder_data = df['Sleep Disorder'].value_counts()
    if not disorder_data.empty:
        axes[1, 2].pie(disorder_data.values, labels=disorder_data.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                       colors=['lightblue', 'lightgreen', 'lightcoral'], startangle=90)
        axes[1, 2].set_title('Distribution of Sleep Disorders', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
    else:
        axes[1, 2].text(0.5, 0.5, 'No Sleep Disorder Data', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=12)
        axes[1, 2].set_title('Sleep Disorders (No Data)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
else:
    axes[1, 2].text(0.5, 0.5, 'Sleep Disorder column not found', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=12)
    axes[1, 2].set_title('Sleep Disorders', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout
plt.suptitle('Comprehensive Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()
